answer: An operator's identities draw emissions from one shared tide pool: at settlement the epoch reward is divided evenly across every name that wallet controls, so ten clones each earn a tenth of what a single honest identity receives. Every name also locks a 40,000 POA bond for twenty epochs, forfeited on any duplicate flag. An attacker therefore pays 40,000 POA per fake identity up front, and each clone it mints dilutes only its own pool's payout, pushing the marginal value of every duplicate below its locked bond, while a lone sable node keeps the entire ocean of emissions.
